'''''Tarasin Dream''''' was a merchant [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that was registered on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
On one occasion during the Clone Wars, the ''Dream'' was traveling as part of a convoy when it dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and entered the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, it was attacked by some [[Thaereian military]] [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], which claimed that it was running contraband. The ''Dream'' could not fight back, as it was unarmed, so it sent out a distress. This was detected by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who attacked the Thaereian Headhunters and tried to save it.
